naturalSeries.statisticalLimitation: Small sequential loopback sample, stopped on failure; not an estimate of in-game probability.

confirmedMechanism: This request was rejected by the existing residual limit with an available complete received pose whose context matched. Its received position lagged the owner pre-E snapshot. It was not the missing-sample branch and was not using the rendered pose.
unresolved: Why a newer authoritative pose was not available before this RPC: sender production/commit timing, transit, or message handling order are not distinguished by this capture. No packet-send sequence trace collected.

instrumentation.hotPath: Bounded per-instance value snapshots; no file IO or formatting during validation
instrumentation.export: JSON after RPC response before test assertions
instrumentation.behaviorChanges: No tolerance, RPC payload, retry, physics, or movement behavior changes

validation: Final strict Fast and unfiltered Gameplay are reported separately in final-validation.json
